# Equal-budget LSTM at 72 h and 168 h: single test evaluation (generated by `scripts/run_long_lstm_tuning.py`)

Git commit `2aece9e5f2`. LSTM L4, 30 random trials per horizon in the widened space plus the original configuration re-evaluated; selection on validation only. MAE in MW.

## Horizon 72 h

| model | test MAE (MW) |
|---|---:|
| LSTM L4, equal budget | 6,200 |
| LSTM L4, original | 6,200 |
| XGBoost S4 | 6,018 |
| ridge | 6,244 |

Equal-budget minus original: +0 MW (95% CI +0 to +0); equal-budget minus XGBoost: +182 MW (CI -201 to +552).

## Horizon 168 h

| model | test MAE (MW) |
|---|---:|
| LSTM L4, equal budget | 8,260 |
| LSTM L4, original | 8,171 |
| XGBoost S4 | 8,173 |
| ridge | 7,743 |

Equal-budget minus original: +90 MW (95% CI +10 to +168); equal-budget minus XGBoost: +87 MW (CI -75 to +233).
